prompt:
47F with MRSA bacteremia from an infected tunneled catheter placed for chemo (catheter removed). Breast cancer on active treatment, otherwise well. Kidney function normal. Levels will be drawn before the morning doses on days 1 and 2.

You are the pharmacist dosing vancomycin for this patient. Target: AUC24 400-600 mg*h/L (MIC assumed 1 mg/L), per our institutional AUC protocol. Each day you get that morning's labs, then you set the regimen that starts that day. Use the tools: get_labs, simulate, submit_dose. Allowed intervals: 8, 12 or 24 h. A loading dose is allowed on day 0 only. This episode runs 5 days (day 0 to day 4).

grader.q_unit: L/h (verdict must match under h-1; see VALIDATION.md)

sources.fact: PK model, parameters, validated covariate ranges
sources.cite: Thomson AH et al. J Antimicrob Chemother. 2009;63(5):1050-1057. doi:10.1093/jac/dkp085
Rybak MJ et al. Am J Health Syst Pharm. 2020;77(11):835-863. doi:10.1093/ajhp/zxaa036

sources.fact: Loading dose limit 20-35 mg/kg, max 3000 mg (secondary summary; full text UNVERIFIED)
Lab error size for drawn levels (additive 1.6 mg/L, proportional 15%)
